tackle.action: a physical tackle or bite: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 crouch low and pull back away from the target, frame 3 lunge the head, chest and front legs far toward the target with the mouth open to bite, frame 4 recover halfway back toward the ready stance; the feet stay on the ground

special.action: an elemental special move WITHOUT drawing the element: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 plant the feet wide and draw the head back inhaling with the chest swelling, frame 3 thrust the head and neck toward the target with the mouth wide open as if blasting a beam out of it (draw NO fire, water, leaves, beam or particles), frame 4 hold the mouth open slightly less; the body stays in place

buff.action: powering up: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 crouch and tense the whole body, frame 3 rear up tall with the chest puffed out and the head raised, roaring, frame 4 settle back toward the ready stance; it stays in place and keeps facing the same way

hurt.action: taking a hit: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 recoil away from the attacker, the head knocked back, eyes squeezed shut and the body flinching, frame 3 recovering most of the way back toward the ready stance

species.name: 잎꼬미
species.design: A baby leaf-lemur starter sitting on all fours in a compact round ball shape: a very big round head (half of its height) with a big plain cream face, a round leaf-green body, two big round leaf-shaped ears, short stubby legs.
species.signature: one long thick tail with three broad cream rings curled into a single big round spiral beside its body, as big as its head
species.accent: soft pink (only one small closed flower bud on its forehead)
species.palette: leaf green, cream, dark forest green, soft pink

species.name: 잎원숭
species.design: The evolved form: a sturdy young leaf-lemur standing UPRIGHT on two legs in a lively balancing pose, one arm raised, a plump solid body (not skinny), a big round head with a big cream face, larger pointed leaf ears, the forehead bud half open.
species.signature: the long ringed tail rising high above its head and curling into a big spiral like a question mark, taller than its body
species.accent: soft pink (only the half-open forehead flower)
species.palette: leaf green, cream, dark forest green, soft pink

species.name: 잎현자
species.design: The final form: a tall, assertive leaf-lemur sage STANDING UPRIGHT and proud with a broad chest and big shoulders, clearly bigger and heavier than its stage 2, one arm raised with an open palm, a big round head with a big cream face and big eyes, a short cape made of only three big broad leaves over its shoulders (no small leaves, no leaf skirt), two large pointed leaf ears. Its ringed tail is a medium ring behind its back, smaller than its body.
species.signature: a psychic aura: a big round pink-violet gem on its forehead inside the opened flower, and two round pink-violet orbs floating in the air beside its head
species.accent: pink-violet (only the forehead gem and the two floating orbs)
species.palette: leaf green, cream, dark forest green, pink-violet

species.name: 잎선인
